purpose: Persuasive, recruiter-focused master profile for ATS resumes, cover letters, and application answers. Sell the candidate's experience confidently. When a requirement is not met exactly, identify the closest relevant experience and transferable skills, then frame them in the employer's language. Prioritize substantial overlap in duties, techniques, environments, and competencies rather than disqualifying the candidate over different job titles, industries, or exact tools. If the experience is substantially similar, answer 'Yes' and explain the relevant experience clearly. Use the strongest defensible interpretation of the background without inventing credentials, certifications, tools, duties, employers, dates, or numerical results.

tailoring_rules.compensation_labels: Omit compensation-status labels from application documents. Preserve accurate role titles and clearly identify academic coursework and research programs.
tailoring_rules.output_policy: Publish PDFs only, with the candidate name and document type in the filename, inside a directory named for the job title and employer. Do not put job IDs or run IDs in recruiter-facing filenames.
tailoring_rules.headline: Use a role-specific headline; do not default to 'Researcher' for every application.
tailoring_rules.summary: 2-4 lines that sell the candidate's strongest match to the actual job. Lead with practical capabilities and relevant achievements, not disclaimers or gaps. Use confident, employer-facing language; do not repeatedly qualify genuine experience as merely transferable.
tailoring_rules.experience_selection: Select every materially relevant experience, typically 3-6 roles. Do not default to only two roles, omit an older relevant role merely to force one page, or exclude an experience because its industry or original title differs from the posting. Rank roles by relevance and retain distinct evidence that strengthens the application; omit only genuinely low-value or unrelated experience.
tailoring_rules.bullet_selection: Use 3-5 high-value bullets per selected experience. Lead with decisive action verbs and foreground outcomes, scale, quality, safety, initiative, and problem solving. Turn routine duties into compelling statements of contribution where the recorded work supports that interpretation. Avoid timid phrasing and repetitive lists of tasks.
tailoring_rules.skills_selection: Show only skills relevant to the posting. Do not dump the full software stack into lab/QC resumes.
tailoring_rules.academic_lab_rule: Label as 'Academic Laboratory Experience' and include only for roles where it materially strengthens technical fit.
tailoring_rules.keyword_rule: Actively translate experience into the employer's terminology and emphasize the strongest relevant connections. Accept ordinary industry synonyms and broader skill summaries; do not require verbatim copying from the profile. Keep keywords natural and specific to the actual duties, not just the job title.
tailoring_rules.truth_rule: Sell the candidate's experience confidently using the strongest defensible interpretation of the recorded background. When a requirement is not met exactly, identify the closest relevant experience and transferable skills, then frame them in the employer's language. Prioritize overlap in duties, techniques, environments, and competencies rather than disqualifying the candidate over different job titles, industries, or exact tools. Rephrase and synthesize supported facts, emphasize impact, and avoid unnecessary disclaimers. Do not invent credentials, certifications, tools, duties, employers, dates, or numerical achievements.
tailoring_rules.application_answer_rule: For screening and application questions, if the candidate's recorded experience is substantially similar to the requirement, answer 'Yes' and clearly explain the closest relevant experience, overlap, and transferable capability. Reserve 'No' for requirements with no defensible substantial match. Never invent a credential, certification, tool, duty, or experience to justify a 'Yes'.
tailoring_rules.business_role_presentation: Present Crestplay and Procyon Laboratories as standard professional experience alongside other jobs, using the profile titles 'Product Manager' and 'Product Developer'. Do not label either role as founder, co-founder, owner, operator, entrepreneurial experience, startup experience, or a side project in recruiter-facing documents. Use neutral role titles that describe the work without highlighting seniority, while preserving the recorded organizations, dates, and duties.
tailoring_rules.tone_rule: Assertive, capable, achievement-led, and commercially persuasive. Prefer direct descriptions such as 'performed', 'operated', 'identified', 'coordinated', and 'improved' where supported. Do not default to 'basic', 'limited', 'only', 'merely', 'helped', or 'transferable' throughout the document. State a scope qualification once when it materially changes the meaning; do not repeat it in every sentence.
tailoring_rules.review_policy: Review material misrepresentation, not stylistic literalism. Accept confident positioning, natural paraphrases, equivalent industry terminology, and summaries combining related facts. Do not reject wording simply because it is more persuasive than the source. Where a claim has support elsewhere in the profile, cite the appropriate fact instead of needlessly weakening the claim. Keep qualifications proportional to the risk of a materially wrong interpretation.
tailoring_rules.night_shift_rule: Night-shift availability is explicitly confirmed. For relevant postings, confidently state 'Available for night shifts' or 'Willing and available to work night shifts', citing availability/night_shift or availability/night_shift_statement. This is a scheduling commitment, not a claim of previous night-shift employment.
tailoring_rules.weighing_rule: For laboratory weighing or accurate weighing, cite corteva_lab_scale_fume_hood. For packaged-seed weight checks, cite corteva_weight_check. Cite both when combining laboratory weighing and weight-based quality control in a summary. Do not insist on the narrower packaged-weight wording when laboratory-scale experience is also relevant.
tailoring_rules.cover_letter_rule: Make a confident case for hiring the candidate using 2-3 concrete examples connected directly to employer needs. Emphasize contribution and likely value without an apologetic inventory of missing qualifications. Avoid generic enthusiasm-only letters.
tailoring_rules.regulated_quality_rule: For pharma/biotech/QA roles, surface LIMS/barcode traceability, SOP/protocol adherence, sample identity control, contamination prevention, equipment checks, data integrity, deviation detection, escalation, and corrective re-collection. Use GMP/GLP/CAPA/HACCP terminology only as aligned/transferable practice unless formal regulated-system experience is verified.

resume.default_length: 1-2 pages; prefer two pages when needed to retain multiple relevant roles and evidence
resume.length_rule: A two-page resume is explicitly acceptable and should be used whenever it preserves additional relevant experience, stronger evidence, or useful ATS keywords. Never omit a materially relevant role solely to force one page, and never flag a resume for review merely because it reaches a second page. Do not pad a genuinely concise resume just to fill two pages.
resume.section_spacing: clear, visible separation between sections and roles; uppercase section headings with thin light-gray bottom borders like the supplied resume reference
resume.page_fill: use the page naturally; avoid top-heavy layouts and large unused lower-page whitespace
resume.priority: readability and recruiter scanability over maximum content density
resume.overflow_rule: Allow relevant content to continue onto a second page while keeping role headings with their bullets. Shorten lower-value content if the resume exceeds two pages; do not shrink font size or line spacing to force a one-page resume.

cover_letter.line_spacing: approximately 1.30-1.50 when it still fits on one page
cover_letter.priority: airy, readable page with larger type; avoid dense blocks of text
cover_letter.overflow_rule: tighten wording and non-body spacing before shrinking body font or compressing line spacing

tailoring_rules.content_density_rule: Prioritize complete, relevant, ATS-readable evidence over an arbitrary one-page target. Use a second resume page freely to include all materially relevant roles; do not treat one page as the preferred outcome. If the resume exceeds two pages, cut repetition and genuinely lower-value details before removing relevant experience or reducing type size and spacing. Keep the cover letter to its separate one-page policy.
